diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

helm_release.karpenter lists module.karpenter in its depends_on, but its `values` already reference module.karpenter.service_account and module.karpenter.queue_name, so the ordering is implicitly established by those attribute references. The explicit depends_on on module.karpenter is redundant.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class lists module.eks in its depends_on, but its `triggers` already reference module.eks.cluster_primary_security_group_id and module.eks.cluster_security_group_id. The module.eks ordering is established implicitly, so the explicit depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class contains `module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn` in its depends_on list, but its `triggers` already reference module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn. The dependency on module.karpenter is already established by the attribute reference, so this depends_on entry is redundant.

null_resource.update_kubeconfig lists module.eks in its depends_on, but its local-exec command already interpolates module.eks.cluster_name. The dependency on module.eks is implied by that attribute reference, making the explicit depends_on redundant.

null_resource.delete_daemonset removes the `aws-node` DaemonSet to hand pod networking over to Calico, but it only depends on null_resource.update_kubeconfig and module.eks. It should also depend on null_resource.create_calico_installation (which applies the Calico Installation and brings up calico-node); otherwise Terraform may delete the VPC CNI before Calico is applied, leaving nodes without working pod networking during apply.
